invariants.rationale: The instantTime is expected to be a valid identifier for the commit instant and should not be null before method execution.
The partition identifier should not be null to ensure correct bucket retrieval and upsert partitioning.
A valid partitioner is needed for casting and subsequent method calls in the upsert process.
The iterator of records to upsert must not be null to guarantee that records can be processed.
Partition indexes are typically non-negative; negative partition values may indicate a logic error.
